causal_contract.entry: After FVG completion, a later completed bar must touch the FVG and close back beyond its midpoint in the trade direction; entry is the following 15-minute open.
causal_contract.mss_fvg: Within a frozen bar window, the opposite-direction displacement body closes through the frozen pivot and the completed three-candle sequence leaves a same-direction wick FVG.
causal_contract.pivot: A pivot with symmetric left/right strength becomes available only after the right-side bars have closed; the most recent available pivot at the sweep is frozen for MSS.
causal_contract.same_bar_exit: Protective stop before target; adverse observed open for stop gaps.
causal_contract.smt: Target wicks through its own corresponding external level and closes back inside while the directed reference never wicks through its own corresponding level on the same completed bar.
causal_contract.stop: Sweep extreme plus or minus frozen ATR buffer.
causal_contract.target: Opposing external liquidity from the same previous-day or previous-week range known at the sweep.
causal_contract.unresolved: No forced period close; unresolved positions are recorded and cannot support a fit or development gate.

conditional_decision.if_survivor_exists: Expand the frozen survivor across all remaining pre-2024 data and exact Bybit BBO/depth before opening official 2024.
conditional_decision.if_zero_full_survivors: Close the exact calendar-liquidity SMT-MSS-displacement-FVG-mitigation dependency and do not retune adjacent thresholds.

data_contract.integrity: Raw JSON-page payload hashes, normalized CSV hashes, row counts and continuity diagnostics are recorded.

non_overlap.active_microshock: No sub-second trade-flow or leader-return shock is used.
non_overlap.active_session_range: No Asian/London/New-York range or kill-zone rule is used.
non_overlap.prior_cross_asset_smt: The reported 192-policy SMT study used generic rolling 12/48-bar boundaries and immediate next-open sweep reversal or breadth catch-up. This claim uses fixed calendar external liquidity, directed peer non-confirmation, confirmed causal pivot MSS, displacement FVG formation and mitigation/rejection before entry.
non_overlap.reported_sweep_models: A sweep alone never triggers entry; MSS plus displacement FVG plus mitigation rejection are mandatory.

objective: Test whether pairwise SMT non-confirmation at fixed previous-day or previous-week external liquidity, followed by causal market-structure shift, displacement FVG and confirmed mitigation, produces repeatable after-cost Bybit USDT-perpetual reversal alpha.
prohibitions: no pivot before its right-side confirmation closes
no entry on the sweep, MSS or FVG completion bar
no live, paper or testnet orders
no rank promotion from this fatal screen

pre_cutoff_source.role: liquidity taken -> displacement through causal swing -> FVG -> seek opposing liquidity

trader_explanation.name: Calendar Liquidity SMT Displacement-FVG Reversal
sequence: One correlated contract raids known buy-side or sell-side liquidity while its peer fails to confirm the raid.
The raiding contract closes back inside the external level.
A causal market-structure shift occurs through the last pivot known at the raid.
The shift has displacement and leaves a three-candle fair value gap.
Price mitigates the gap and rejects its consequent encroachment.
Enter next bar; stop beyond the raid; target the opposing external liquidity.
